# Reference-program fixtures

These four unchanged minimal-JSON programs are from the Text2CAD-derived
Text-to-3D dataset release. They are data, not MIT-licensed implementation code.
Text2CAD is by Mohammad Sadil Khan and collaborators and is distributed under
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SadilKhan/Text2CAD.
The fixtures retain that attribution, non-commercial and share-alike license.
